12: /-! # λ-calculus
13: 
14: The λ-calculus with polymorphism and subtyping, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
15: This file defines the typing relation.
16: 
17: ## References
18: 
19: * [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
20: * See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
21:   this is adapted
22: 
23: -/
24: 
25: @[expose] public section
26: 
27: namespace Cslib
28: 
29: variable {Var : Type*} [DecidableEq Var] [HasFresh Var]
30: 
31: namespace LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub
32: 
33: open Term Ty Ty.Wf Env.Wf Fsub.Sub Context List Binding

35: /-- The typing relation. -/
36: inductive Typing : Env Var → Term Var → Ty Var → Prop
37:   | var : Γ.Wf → Binding.ty σ ∈ Γ.dlookup x → Typing Γ (fvar x) σ
38:   | abs (L : Finset Var) :
39:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
40:       Typing Γ (abs σ t₁) (arrow σ τ)
41:   | app : Typing Γ t₁ (arrow σ τ) → Typing Γ t₂ σ → Typing Γ (app t₁ t₂) τ
42:   | tabs (L : Finset Var) :
43:       (∀ X ∉ L, Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₁ ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (τ ^ᵞ fvar X)) →
44:       Typing Γ (tabs σ t₁) (all σ τ)
45:   | tapp : Typing Γ t₁ (all σ τ) → Sub Γ σ' σ → Typing Γ (tapp t₁ σ') (τ ^ᵞ σ')
46:   | sub : Typing Γ t τ → Sub Γ τ τ' → Typing Γ t τ'
47:   | let' (L : Finset Var) :
48:       Typing Γ t₁ σ →
49:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) τ) →
50:       Typing Γ (let' t₁ t₂) τ
51:   | inl : Typing Γ t₁ σ → τ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inl t₁) (sum σ τ)
52:   | inr : Typing Γ t₁ τ → σ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inr t₁) (sum σ τ)
53:   | case (L : Finset Var) :
54:       Typing Γ t₁ (sum σ τ) →
55:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ) (t₂ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
56:       (∀ x ∉ L, Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Γ) (t₃ ^ᵗᵗ fvar x) δ) →
57:       Typing Γ (case t₁ t₂ t₃) δ
58: 
59: namespace Typing
60: 
61: variable {Γ Δ Θ : Env Var} {σ τ δ : Ty Var}
62: 
63: attribute [grind .] Typing.var Typing.app Typing.tapp Typing.sub Typing.inl Typing.inr
64:

66: /-- Typings have well-formed contexts and types. -/
67: @[grind →]
68: lemma wf {Γ : Env Var} {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Var} (der : Typing Γ t τ) : Γ.Wf ∧ t.LC ∧ τ.Wf Γ := by
69:   induction der <;> let L := free_union Var <;> have ⟨x, nmem⟩ := fresh_exists L
70:   case tabs ih =>
71:     cases (ih x (by grind)).left
72:     split_ands
73:     · grind
74:     · apply LC.tabs L <;> grind
75:     · apply Ty.Wf.all L <;> grind
76:   case abs ih =>
77:     cases (ih x (by grind)).left
78:     grind [LC.abs L, Wf.strengthen]
79:   case let' => grind [LC.let' L, Ty.Wf.strengthen]
80:   case case => refine ⟨?_, LC.case L ?_ ?_ ?_, ?_⟩ <;> grind [Ty.Wf.strengthen]
81:   case var => grind [of_bind_ty]
82:   case app => grind only [LC.app, cases Ty.Wf]
83:   all_goals grind [open_lc]
84: 
85: /-- Weakening of typings. -/
86: lemma weaken (der : Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).Wf) :
87:     Typing (Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ) t τ := by
88:   generalize eq : Γ ++ Δ = ΓΔ at der
89:   induction der generalizing Γ
90:   case' abs => apply abs ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var)
91:   case' tabs => apply tabs ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var)
92:   case' let' der _ => apply let' ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var) (der wf eq)
93:   case' case der _ _ => apply case ((Γ ++ Θ ++ Δ).dom ∪ free_union Var) (der wf eq)
94:   all_goals
95:     grind [Wf.weaken, Sub.weaken, Wf.of_env_ty, Wf.of_env_sub, Sub.refl, <= sublist_dlookup]
96: 
97: /-- Weakening of typings (at the front). -/
98: lemma weaken_head (der : Typing Δ t τ) (wf : (Γ ++ Δ).Wf) :
99:     Typing (Γ ++ Δ) t τ := by
100:   have eq : Δ = [] ++ Δ := by rfl
101:   rw [eq] at der
102:   grind [Typing.weaken der wf]
103: 
104: /-- Narrowing of typings. -/
105: lemma narrow (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) :
106:     Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ⟩ :: Δ) t τ := by
107:   generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
108:   induction der generalizing Γ
109:   case var X' _ _ =>
110:     grind [Env.Wf.narrow, List.perm_nodupKeys, => List.perm_dlookup]
111:   case' abs  => apply abs (free_union Var)
112:   case' tabs => apply tabs (free_union Var)
113:   case' let' der _ => apply let' (free_union Var) (der eq)
114:   case' case der _ _ => apply case (free_union Var) (der eq)
115:   all_goals grind [Ty.Wf.narrow, Env.Wf.narrow, Sub.narrow]
116: 
117: /-- Term substitution within a typing. -/
118: lemma subst_tm (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (der_sub : Typing Δ s σ) :
119:     Typing (Γ ++ Δ) (t[X := s]) τ := by
120:   generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
121:   induction der generalizing Γ X
122:   case var σ' _ X' _ _ =>
123:     have : Γ ++ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: Δ ~ ⟨X, .ty σ⟩ :: (Γ ++ Δ) := perm_middle
124:     by_cases eq : X = X'
125:     · #adaptation_note
126:       /--
127:       Moving from `nightly-2025-09-15` to `nightly-2025-10-19`,
128:       I've had to remove the `append_assoc` lemma from grind;
129:       without this `grind` is exploding. This requires further investigation.
130:       -/
131:       grind [→ List.mem_dlookup, weaken_head, Env.Wf.strengthen, -append_assoc]
132:     · grind [Env.Wf.strengthen, => List.perm_dlookup]
133:   case abs => grind [abs (free_union Var), openTm_substTm_var]
134:   case tabs => grind [tabs (free_union Var), openTy_substTm_var]
135:   case let' der _ => grind [let' (free_union Var) (der eq), openTm_substTm_var]
136:   case case der _ _ =>
137:     apply case (free_union Var) (der eq) <;> grind [openTm_substTm_var]
138:   all_goals grind [Env.Wf.strengthen, Ty.Wf.strengthen, Sub.strengthen]
139: 
140: /-- Type substitution within a typing. -/
141: lemma subst_ty (der : Typing (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ) t τ) (sub : Sub Δ δ δ') :
142:     Typing (Γ.mapVal (·[X := δ]) ++ Δ) (t[X := δ]) (τ[X := δ]) := by
143:   generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub δ'⟩ :: Δ = Θ at der
144:   induction der generalizing Γ X
145:   case var σ _ X' _ mem =>
146:     have := map_subst_nmem Δ X δ
147:     have := @mapVal_mem Var (f := ((·[X := δ]) : Binding Var → Binding Var))
148:     grind [Env.Wf.map_subst, → notMem_keys_of_nodupKeys_cons]
149:   case abs => grind [abs (free_union [Ty.fv] Var), Ty.subst_fresh, openTm_substTy_var]
150:   case tabs => grind [tabs (free_union Var), openTy_substTy_var, open_subst_var]
151:   case let' der _ =>
152:     apply let' (free_union Var) (der eq)
153:     grind [openTm_substTy_var]
154:   case case der _ _ =>
155:     apply case (free_union Var) (der eq) <;> grind [openTm_substTy_var]
156:   case tapp => grind [Ty.open_subst, Env.Wf.map_subst, Ty.Wf.map_subst, Sub.map_subst]
157:   all_goals grind [Env.Wf.map_subst, Ty.Wf.map_subst, Sub.map_subst]
158: 
159: open Term Ty
160: 
161: omit [HasFresh Var]

163: /-- Invert the typing of an abstraction. -/
164: lemma abs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.abs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (arrow γ δ)) :
165:      Sub Γ γ γ'
166:   ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ x ∉ (L : Finset Var),
167:     Typing (⟨x, Binding.ty γ'⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵗ .fvar x) δ' ∧ Sub Γ δ' δ := by
168:   generalize eq : Term.abs γ' t = e at der
169:   induction der generalizing t γ' γ δ
170:   case abs τ L _ _ =>
171:     cases eq
172:     cases sub
173:     split_ands
174:     · assumption
175:     · exists τ, L
176:       grind
177:   case sub Γ _ τ τ' _ _ ih =>
178:     subst eq
179:     have sub' : Sub Γ τ (γ.arrow δ) := by grind
180:     obtain ⟨_, δ', L, _⟩ := ih sub' (by rfl)
181:     split_ands
182:     · assumption
183:     · exists δ', L
184:   all_goals grind
185: 
186: variable [HasFresh Var] in
187: /-- Invert the typing of a type abstraction. -/
188: lemma tabs_inv (der : Typing Γ (.tabs γ' t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (all γ δ)) :
189:      Sub Γ γ γ'
190:   ∧ ∃ δ' L, ∀ X ∉ (L : Finset Var),
191:      Typing (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (t ^ᵗᵞ fvar X) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X)
192:      ∧ Sub (⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ) (δ' ^ᵞ fvar X) (δ ^ᵞ fvar X) := by
193:   generalize eq : Term.tabs γ' t = e at der
194:   induction der generalizing γ δ t γ'
195:   case tabs σ Γ _ τ L der _ =>
196:     cases sub with | all L' sub =>
197:     split_ands
198:     · grind
199:     · exists τ, L ∪ L'
200:       intro X _
201:       have eq : ⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ = [] ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub γ⟩ :: Γ := by rfl
202:       grind [narrow]
203:   case sub Γ _ τ τ' _ _ ih =>
204:     subst eq
205:     have sub' : Sub Γ τ (γ.all δ) := by trans τ' <;> grind
206:     obtain ⟨_, δ', L, _⟩ := ih sub' (by rfl)
207:     split_ands
208:     · assumption
209:     · exists δ', L
210:   all_goals grind
211: 
212: set_option linter.tacticAnalysis.verifyGrindOnly false in
213: /-- Invert the typing of a left case. -/
214: lemma inl_inv (der : Typing Γ (.inl t) τ) (sub : Sub Γ τ (sum γ δ)) :
215:     ∃ γ', Typing Γ t γ' ∧ Sub Γ γ' γ := by
216:   generalize eq : t.inl = t at der
217:   induction der generalizing γ δ with
218:   | inl => grind only [cases Sub]

17: ## References
18:

37: /-- Existential predicate for being a locally closed body of an abstraction. -/
38: @[scoped grind =]
39: def body (t : Term Var) := ∃ L : Finset Var, ∀ x ∉ L, LC (t ^ᵗᵗ fvar x)
40: 
41: section
42: 
43: variable {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Term Var}
44: 
45: variable [DecidableEq Var]

47: /-- Locally closed let bindings have a locally closed body. -/
48: @[scoped grind _=_]
49: lemma body_let : (let' t₁ t₂).LC ↔ t₁.LC ∧ t₂.body := by
50:   constructor <;> intro h <;> cases h
51:   case mp.let' L t₁_lc h => exact ⟨t₁_lc, L, h⟩
52:   case mpr.intro body =>
53:     obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := body
54:     grind [LC.let' <| free_union Var]
55: 
56: /-- Locally closed case bindings have a locally closed bodies. -/
57: @[scoped grind _=_]
58: lemma body_case : (case t₁ t₂ t₃).LC ↔ t₁.LC ∧ t₂.body ∧ t₃.body := by
59:   constructor <;> intro h
60:   case mp => cases h with | case L t₁_lc h₂ h₃ => exact ⟨t₁_lc, ⟨L, h₂⟩, ⟨L, h₃⟩⟩
61:   case mpr =>
62:     obtain ⟨_, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := h
63:     grind [LC.case <| free_union Var]
64:

67: /-- Opening a body preserves local closure. -/
68: @[scoped grind <=]
69: lemma open_tm_body (body : t₁.body) (lc : t₂.LC) : (t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂).LC := by
70:   cases body

# `solve_by_elim`, `apply_rules`, and `apply_assumption`.

`solve_by_elim` takes a collection of facts from the local context or
supplied as arguments by the user, and performs a backtracking
depth-first search by attempting to `apply` these facts to the goal.

It is a highly configurable tactic, with options to control the
backtracking, to solve multiple goals simultaneously (with backtracking
between goals), or to supply a discharging tactic for unprovable goals.

`apply_rules` and `apply_assumption` are much simpler tactics which do
not perform backtracking, but are currently implemented in terms of
`solve_by_elim` with backtracking disabled, in order to be able to share
the front-end customisation and parsing of user options. It would be
reasonable to further separate these in future.

open Lean Meta Elab Tactic

namespace Lean.Meta.SolveByElim

initialize registerTraceClass `Meta.Tactic.solveByElim

/--
`applyTactics lemmas goal` will return an iterator that applies the
lemmas to the goal `goal` and returns ones that succeed.

Providing this to the `backtracking` tactic,
we can perform backtracking search based on applying a list of lemmas.

``applyTactics (trace := `name)`` will construct trace nodes for ``name` indicating which
calls to `apply` succeeded or failed.
-/
def applyTactics (cfg : ApplyConfig := {}) (transparency : TransparencyMode := .default)
    (lemmas : List Expr) (g : MVarId) : MetaM (Lean.Meta.Iterator (List Lean.MVarId)) := do
  pure <|
    (← Meta.Iterator.ofList lemmas).filterMapM (fun e => observing? do
      withTraceNode `Meta.Tactic.solveByElim (fun _ => return m!"trying to apply: {e}") do
        let goals ← withTransparency transparency (g.apply e cfg)
        -- When we call `apply` interactively, `Lean.Elab.Tactic.evalApplyLikeTactic`
        -- deals with closing new typeclass goals by calling
        -- `Lean.Elab.Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing`.
        -- It seems we can't reuse that machinery down here in `MetaM`,
        -- so we just settle for trying to close each subgoal using `inferInstance`.
        goals.filterM fun g => try g.inferInstance; pure false catch _ => pure true)

/--
`applyFirst lemmas goal` applies the first of the `lemmas`
which can be successfully applied to `goal`, and fails if none apply.

We use this in `apply_rules` and `apply_assumption` where backtracking is not needed.
-/
def applyFirst (cfg : ApplyConfig := {}) (transparency : TransparencyMode := .default)
    (lemmas : List Expr) (g : MVarId) : MetaM (List MVarId) := do
  (← applyTactics cfg transparency lemmas g).head

open Lean.Meta.Tactic.Backtrack (BacktrackConfig backtrack)

/-- The default `maxDepth` for `apply_rules` is higher. -/
structure ApplyRulesConfig extends BacktrackConfig, ApplyConfig where
  /-- Transparency mode for calls to `apply`. -/
  transparency : TransparencyMode := .default
  /-- Also use symmetric versions (via `@[symm]`) of local hypotheses. -/
  symm : Bool := true
  /-- Try proving the goal via `exfalso` if `solve_by_elim` otherwise fails.
  This is only used when operating on a single goal. -/
  exfalso : Bool := true
  maxDepth := 50

/--
Configuration structure to control the behaviour of `solve_by_elim`:
* transparency mode for calls to `apply`
* whether to use `symm` on hypotheses and `exfalso` on the goal as needed,
* see also `BacktrackConfig` for hooks allowing flow control.
-/
structure SolveByElimConfig extends ApplyRulesConfig where
  /-- Enable backtracking search. -/
  backtracking : Bool := true
  maxDepth := 6
  /-- Trying calling `intro` if no lemmas apply. -/
  intro : Bool := true
  /-- Try calling `constructor` if no lemmas apply. -/

namespace SolveByElimConfig

instance : Coe SolveByElimConfig BacktrackConfig := ⟨(·.toApplyRulesConfig.toBacktrackConfig)⟩

/-- Create or modify a `Config` which allows a class of goals to be returned as subgoals. -/
def accept (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) (test : MVarId → MetaM Bool) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  { cfg with
    discharge := fun g => do
      if (← test g) then
        pure none
      else
        cfg.discharge g }

/--
Create or modify a `Config` which runs a tactic on the main goal.
If that tactic fails, fall back to the `proc` behaviour of `cfg`.
-/
def mainGoalProc (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) (proc : MVarId → MetaM (List MVarId)) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  { cfg with
    proc := fun orig goals => match goals with
    | [] => cfg.proc orig []
    | g :: gs => try
        return (← proc g) ++ gs
      catch _ => cfg.proc orig goals }

/-- Create or modify a `Config` which calls `intro` on each goal before applying lemmas. -/
-- Because `SolveByElim` works on each goal in sequence, even though
-- `mainGoalProc` only applies this operation on the main goal,
-- it is applied to every goal before lemmas are applied.
def intros (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  cfg.mainGoalProc fun g => do pure [(← g.intro1P).2]

/-- Add a discharging tactic, falling back to the original discharging tactic if it fails.
Return `none` to return the goal as a new subgoal, or `some goals` to replace it. -/
def withDischarge (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) (discharge : MVarId → MetaM (Option (List MVarId))) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  { cfg with
    discharge := fun g => try discharge g
      catch _ => cfg.discharge g }

/-- Create or modify a `SolveByElimConfig` which calls `intro` on any goal for which no lemma applies. -/
def introsAfter (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  cfg.withDischarge fun g => do pure [(← g.intro1P).2]

/-- Call `constructor` when no lemmas apply. -/
def constructorAfter (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  cfg.withDischarge fun g => g.constructor {newGoals := .all}

/-- Create or modify a `Config` which
calls `synthInstance` on any goal for which no lemma applies. -/
def synthInstanceAfter (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  cfg.withDischarge fun g => do
    g.assign (← Lean.Meta.synthInstance (← g.getType))
    pure (some [])

/--
Create or modify a `Config` which rejects branches for which `test`,
applied to the instantiations of the original goals, fails or returns `false`.
-/
def testPartialSolutions (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) (test : List Expr → MetaM Bool) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  { cfg with
    proc := fun orig goals => do
      guard <| ← test (← orig.mapM fun m => m.withContext do instantiateMVars (.mvar m))
      cfg.proc orig goals }

/--
Create or modify a `SolveByElimConfig` which rejects complete solutions for which `test`,
applied to the instantiations of the original goals, fails or returns `false`.
-/
def testSolutions (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) (test : List Expr → MetaM Bool) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  cfg.testPartialSolutions fun sols => do
    if sols.any Expr.hasMVar then
      pure true
    else
      test sols

/--
Create or modify a `Config` which only accept solutions
for which every expression in `use` appears as a subexpression.
-/
def requireUsingAll (cfg : SolveByElimConfig := {}) (use : List Expr) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  cfg.testSolutions fun sols => do
    pure <| use.all fun e => sols.any fun s => e.occurs s

/--
Process the `intro` and `constructor` options by implementing the `discharger` tactic.
-/
def processOptions (cfg : SolveByElimConfig) : SolveByElimConfig :=
  let cfg := if cfg.intro then introsAfter { cfg with intro := false } else cfg
  let cfg := if cfg.constructor then constructorAfter { cfg with constructor := false } else cfg
  cfg

end SolveByElimConfig
